name: AIAgentResponseGroup
description: AIAgentResponseGroup is the primary conversational AI message group. It composes AIMessageHeader, AIMessageBody, and optional action or footer layers into a single branded card.
intent: A flexible conversational card that upgrades from plain text to actions, alerts, or full footer — controlled by a single variant prop.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: agentLabel
props.hint: Agent name shown in the attribution header.

props.name: children
props.hint: Body content. Use <strong> with brand color for inline emphasis.

props.name: alertLabel
props.hint: Label text inside the orange alert sub-row. Only visible in with-alert variant.

props.name: primaryAction
props.hint: Primary pill button. Visible in with-actions and with-alert variants.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.hint: Secondary outline pill button. Visible in with-actions and with-alert variants.

props.name: sources
props.hint: Source chips passed to AIResponseFooter. Only used in with-footer variant.

props.name: showFeedback
props.hint: Shows thumbs up/down feedback bar in AIResponseFooter. Only used in with-footer variant.

notes: Use AI tokens from ai-tokens.ts — do not hardcode brand hex.
Fetch dependency atomics from components/ai/ mirror specs.
Self-contained under components/ai/ — do not require an external AI UI package.

keyboard: Ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order
